title: The Herdt Campus All-you-can-read range offers members of ETH Zurich free access to the latest software handbooks.
main_content:
The Herdt Campus All-you-can-read range offers members of ETH Zurich free access to the latest software handbooks.

Access requires a one-off registration and is possible online in ETH Zurich's network or on ETH-Bibliothek premises.

Access via the Knowledge Portal of ETH-Bibliothek
